q: give me a net profit breakdown, waterfall for September 2026
answer:
Net profit for September 2026 was a loss of ₹172,227 (order-date P&L basis). That loss happened because marketing spend exceeded the month’s contribution margin.

- Biggest hits: Ad spend (ad spend (P&L basis)) = ₹1,193,322 — larger than the contribution margin, driving the negative net profit.  
- Revenue and top-line: Net sales (net sales (P&L basis)) = ₹1,697,336 from Gross sales = ₹2,253,539 after − Discounts ₹110,359, − Returns ₹371,999 and − Cancels ₹73,845. Returns alone subtracted ₹371,999 from gross.  
- Costs inside contribution margin: Net COGS = ₹676,241 (Product cost ₹553,170 + Operating cost ₹123,071). Operating cost breakdown: Shipping ₹76,743, Packaging ₹18,237, Payment fees ₹12,919, RTO ₹15,171.  
- Result: Contribution margin = ₹1,021,095; minus Ad spend ₹1,193,322 = Net profit −₹172,227.

Worth checking: ad efficiency (ROAS) and the return rate — reducing either would materially improve profit (ad spend ≈ 117% of contribution margin).

Period: 2026-09-01..2026-09-30 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-14
